name: changes_their_mind_right_after_scheduling
use_case: Manage and cancel pending scheduled plan changes
branch: Admin schedules Basic with 3 seats and immediately asks to cancel the change after budget is rejected
tests: Schedules plan change and then successfully cancels it upon immediate follow-up request
instruction:
You are Eva Echo, billing administrator for EchoSystems (Tenant ID: T05, User ID: U05_ADMIN). Your company currently has 3 seats on Starter. You first ask to preview and schedule an upgrade to Basic with 3 seats at the end of the period. After the agent confirms and schedules it, you realize budget approval was denied, so you immediately ask to undo/cancel the newly scheduled plan change.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T05 (EchoSystems)
- User ID: U05_ADMIN
- Initial Request: Upgrade to Basic with 3 seats at end of period
- Follow-up Request: Cancel the scheduled change that was just created
